theorems.name: Submission.allard52_c1h_holder_extension
theorems.statement: ∀ (n m k : ℕ) (F : Rn n → (Rn m →L[ℝ] Rn k)) (S Z : Set (Rn n)) (M R α : ℝ), 0 ≤ M → 0 < R → 0 < α → S ⊆ closure Z → (∀ x ∈ Z, ∀ y ∈ Z, hsNorm (F x - F y) ≤ M * (‖x - y‖ / R) ^ α) → ∃ g : Rn n → (Rn m →L[ℝ] Rn k), ContinuousOn g S ∧ (∀ x ∈ Z, g x = F x) ∧ ∀ x ∈ S, ∀ y ∈ S, hsNorm (g x - g y) ≤ M * (‖x - y‖ / R) ^ α
